segments.en: Hokuto's House
I'm home!
Oh, Dad!
Hey, Hokuto.

Hm?
What's wrong?
Where's your mom?
Well... she's not here.

Not here?
What do you mean...
she's not here?

I don't know...
You don't know either, Dad?

That's strange...
She never told me she had
anything going on today...

When I got home...
the front door was locked,
and inside... it was pitch dark.

What about Grandpa's place?
Did you try calling there?
No...

I was tired yesterday,
so I just went straight to sleep.
I see...

Hey, Dad...
What do you think happened to Mom?

Don't worry... I'm sure she's
still waiting it out in a
shelter somewhere.
Yeah... you're right.

Oh!
Maybe that's Mom!
Huh...?
Hello, Hokuto...
Ah...
Commander...
I'm Shibuya, the commander.

There is something I must
tell you, Mr. Kusanagi...

Hokuto...?!
You're...
the pilot of Dendoh...?

Please don't blame Hokuto
for not telling you...

We were the ones...
who made him keep it secret.
Commander...

Hokuto... and Ginga. The two
of them were chosen by Dendoh.
Chosen... by Dendoh...?

Hokuto and Ginga could draw out
more of Dendoh's power than Orie.

For that reason alone,
we ended up relying
on these children.

Commander...
You just said Mom's name...

Yes. If you two hadn't been
chosen... Orie was the one who
would have fought in Dendoh.

As Dendoh's pilot...
and as GEAR's vice-commander,
Vega...!
Fight......? Orie...?

...What?!
No way...
Then...
Vega is...... Mom...?

Ah!
Then that means...!

I'm sorry...
Hokuto...!

Ngh!!
I can't just sit here!
Hokuto!!

That guy kidnapped her!
Mom...!!
I've got to go save her!!

Kidnapped...?
......Orie was?

Wait!
Hokuto!!
Ugh...! Mom!

I'll... I'll come
and save you!!

rows.notes: Seg 6 (blank header) read as Keisuke asking. Seg 47 'aitsu' = the enemy who took Vega (Arthea/Ouga); rendered 'that guy'. Shibuya's gender unknown: no pronouns used for Shibuya. | [editorial 32] run-on: name list and clause split into two sentences

segments.en: GEAR HQ: Hangar
Owwwww...

Hey! Hokuto!
What's gotten into you,
rushing around like that?

Vega...
She was my mom.
Huh?

Mom... didn't come home...
and then Commander Shibuya came
and said Vega...... is Mom...

The one Ouga kidnapped...
it was my mom!!
No way......

So I'm going
to save Mom!!

H-Hold on a sec!
You don't even know
where that guy is!

But...!
Mom's...!!
Just calm down, already!
Waaaaaaaaah!!

Now I get...
what's going on.

But right now,
all we can do is wait.
Okay...

I know it's a shock...
But you've got to hang in there.
Got it, Hokuto?

Kanji... please...
train me.
I can't just sit still.
All right.

The Dendoh Team's piloting
level went up by 4.
Good work today, Kanji!

Hey, Elise.
Thanks for helping out
with the training.
Not at all...
How's Hokuto?
...He was worn out, so he's asleep.
I see...

I'm worried about Hokuto,
but Galfa's on my mind too...

So I've got a lot of things
I want to ask Vega myself.

That last battle gave us a look at
the connection between Galfa
and the Redros Army...

rows.notes: Seg 6: [jp] = Arthea's Knight Ouga (term_fixes: Ouga). Seg 8 'uso...' has no header; Ginga most likely (only Ginga and Hokuto present) -- kept neutral 'No way'. | [editorial 9] 'going to go' clunky; [jp] object restored | [editorial 28] [jp]: 'bugging me' read as annoyance (accuracy flag)

segments.en:
Oh, Kanji.
We're about to depart.
Roger!
"Depart" is now available.

Even if we don't know where
the enemy's remaining forces are,
we can't just sit on our hands!
First, we act!

Do that, and the path
will reveal itself!

Iron Gear!
Launch!

We'll hunt down the enemies left
in Asia and drive them off!

rows.notes: Header of seg 0 is Master Asia (archaic speech fits); segs 1-3 kept as his. Seg 5 (no header) follows Elchi's launch order and is read as hers.

segments.en:
The Iron Gear and Grados...
Let them fight, then take Dendoh.

An ignoble way for a knight to fight,
but it cannot be helped if I am
to present Dendoh to His Majesty...

Kanji!
Come to the Nu Gundam's
cockpit right away!
What's up?
Look, Kanji.

The Gundam's Psycho-Frame
is resonating!

Don't tell me...
Is a gate opening again?

This feeling... I've got it!
It's where Quess and the
others vanished before!

All right!
Let's go check it out!

Looks like nothing's
happened yet.
No... here it comes!

Whoa!!
It really came!!
Something's coming down!

It's a mobile suit
I've never seen before.

Hm...?!
Hathaway, is that you?!

You're saying Hathaway's
riding in that thing?
Where... am I?

Quess...
What should I do?
Show me the way...

Hathaway...
Long time no see.

Huh...?
Amuro?

Ah!
Please wait!
I'll open the hatch now!

I can't believe it!
I just got here, and I've
already run into Amuro!

I'm surprised too.
I never imagined you'd be
the one to come, Hathaway.

Anyway, that's quite a
machine you came in on.
Is that really a mobile suit?

Unusual, isn't it?
That's because it's equipped
with a Minovsky Craft system.

It lets the suit fly through
the sky while still heavily armed.

Impressive...
Have they already put tech like
this into service over there?

It's an experimental unit, as
usual. I doubt something like
this will ever be mass-produced...
What's it called?

This is the
"Xi Gundam."
This is a Gundam?

Haha!
I knew you'd be surprised.

I'll take you to the ship now.
I've got a mountain of questions
about how things are over there.
Thanks. I'm glad to be aboard.
Hathaway has joined the unit.
The Xi Gundam has been deployed.

rows.notes: Seg 4 has no header; left as a line from Amuro or Kanji (neutral wording). | [editorial 18] 'It lets it' unclear | [editorial 24] [jp]: 'It surprises everyone' generalised (accuracy flag)

segments.en: Arthea Fleet Flagship

Like that, you look just
as you did long ago... Vega.
Arthea...

What is the meaning of this?
Arthea...
...No... Brother...

Ah...
No...
Are you truly...?!

For reasons of my own,
I cannot remove
this mask at present.

But make no mistake,
I am your brother, Arthea.

It is no wonder you cannot
believe it at once.
It was... the same for me.

Vega... I never dreamed
you could still be alive...

But...!
Then why?
Why side with Galfa, of all things?!

Emperor Galfa saved us both,
and to this day he fights,
wishing for peace in the universe.
What...?

Out of concern for me,
His Majesty in his kindness
sealed away my memories.
His Majesty...?

The memories of our planet's end...
so painful, so full of sorrow...

Better that I have none of them
at all, for my own sake--
so His Majesty judged...

But when I met you again, and
my sealed memories began to stir,
His Majesty could not bear my pain,

and returned all of them
to me.
Brother...

Yet truly, I would have been
happier not knowing...

That you, my one and only sister,
whom they carried off that day...

you, the sister I loved so dearly
that even with my memories sealed
some part of my heart remembered...!

Deceived or not, to think you have
joined the evil humans who take
up arms against Emperor Galfa!
Brother, what are you saying?!

Brother!
Those are false memories!

The one that suddenly rose up
and attacked our planet

was Galfa--our planet's
biocomputer, gone mad and out
of control! Was it not?!

That is what they have made
you believe!
Vega!
They have deceived you...!

Those humans who would topple
His Majesty and plunge the whole
universe into endless turmoil!
Brother...!

It is you who are mistaken!
It is you who have been
deceived, Brother!!
What!!

Those memories of yours, Brother...
they are not the truth!
Enough!

Everything that cast us
into such a fate...!
I shall destroy it all!!

rows.notes: Seg 10: [jp] 'us both'. Emperor Galfa is referred to as 'he' once (seg 10), following Arthea's view of the Emperor as a person. Segs 28-29 one sentence split across pages ([jp] / ...[jp]); English split at the same point. | [editorial 1] dangling modifier 'Seeing you like that, you look'

segments.en: Whoa!
Hm?

What is it,
Light?

Well, well...
Looks like we won't have
to go looking for the enemy...

They've come to us,
all bunched together!

What the hell is that?!
There's a crazy number of 'em!

I can't believe there were
still that many left...!

Most of them are
Claudian-built cruisers.

There's no doubt the Redros
Army is behind this!
Here they come!
All units, prepare to intercept!!

rows.notes: Seg 2 has no header; read as Kanji continuing.

segments.en:
I waited for them to fight
Grados, but I can bear it
no longer!

Demons who brainwashed my sister
Vega and use her as evil's pawn!
I'll not rest till I bury you myself!!

That bastard!
Let's go, Hokuto!
Command Install!

rows.notes: Seg 3 [jp] rendered 'Command Install!' (no established form found in other slices). | [proofread 0] style sheet: plain 'Grados'

segments.en:
You!
If not for the likes of you...!
Give my mom back!!
What?!

Hokuto!!
Ginga!
Hokutooo!!

Vega's son?
You?

...I see.
So that is why you
can move Dendoh.
Waaaaaah!!
So your mother taught you this?!

That you fight for
the peace of this universe!

Is that why you fight?!
Dendoh!!

Are you so eager to bring war?
So thirsty for blood?
Foolish humans!

As long as Dendoh fights, peace
will never come to this
universe, now or ever!!

Deceived or not, would you
drag even your own son into
such darkness?! Vega!!

rows.notes: [editorial 10] rhetorical accusing question restored in tone (accuracy flag); k11-k12 flow kept

segments.en:
Hear me!!
Pilot of Dendoh!

No...
Son of Vega!

Vega is my sister, from whom
I was torn apart in the year
4085 of the Arktos Era!
Huh...?
His sister?!

Carried off by the enemy, taught
that we of Galfa are the ones
who bring harm to the universe,

she threw herself into this war--
my foolish sister!

Mom is...
that guy's sister?

If Dendoh believes those words
and fights on,

then nothing can save
this universe from war!

No!
That's not true!

Hokuto!!
Ginga!!

The other Gear, which brings
ruin and chaos!!
I shall destroy it, nothing more!!

rows.notes: Seg 4: [jp] 'Arktos Era' (term_fixes: Arktos); 'Era' is my choice for [jp]. Seg 7 [jp] given to Hokuto per header: 'His sister!?'. Seg 15: [jp] 'the other Gear' (Dendoh as the other Gear besides Ouga) -- unverified.

segments.en:
Dammit!
They just keep coming!

If you abandon Dendoh, I shall
grant you a reprieve, son of Vega.

I may even let the Iron Gear
escape from this battlefield!
Give up Dendoh?!

Even I have no wish
to cause more tragedy!

What will it be?!
Son of Vega!

Ngh...
Give my mom baaack!
I see... Then so be it!!

Viper Whip,
install!
Kyaaaah!

Dammit!
What power!!
This is the end!
Arthea!!
Hm?

Stop this fighting!
Arthea!!
What?!

Though I know it not myself,
I am the one who holds the key
to Dendoh's secret!

If you continue this battle...!
I will end my own life,
here and now!

Vega!!
What are you doing?!
Damn it all!!

Very well, Vega!
Wait until I return to the ship!
Nngh...!

LORD ARTHEA...!
I HAVE A REPORT.
Mm...

SPACE-TIME TREMORS
ARE BEING OBSERVED.

SOON... THE GATE...
WILL... OPEN...
What?!
Nngh...!

LORD ARTHEA...
WHAT ARE YOUR ORDERS...?

The battle is not over!
Do not lift the encirclement!
UNDERSTOOD...

What the?!
A gate that huge?!

Wh-What in the world
is that...!
Kyaaaaaah!!
Nnngh!

A fleet that size!!
Did they summon it here?!

rows.notes: Segs 25-33: UNKNOWN speaker writes in katakana (robotic Galfa voice); rendered with plain clipped English and ellipses, no special casing. segments.en:
I am Char Aznable,
Supreme Leader of Neo Zeon.

Our fleet has entered the area
to maintain the safety and
order of Paradigm City,

at the request of Mr. Alex,
who governs Paradigm City.

Accordingly, we strongly desire
an alliance with your forces,
who also protect this city.
Char...? But why?!

Quess must have brought them.
I can sense her presence too...
What's going on?

He's the one we were fighting
back when we were in space...

So why's he coming to us
wanting to form an alliance?
I'll go ask him myself.

rows.notes: Seg 5: [jp] -- object unstated; 'them' (Char and his fleet).

segments.en:
We're going to
meet Char now.
All right?
Yeah...

Neo Zeon Fleet
Flagship: Bridge

Colonel!
Amuro and Kanji are here.

We're here representing the Iron
Gear: Lieutenant Kanji Akatsuki and
Lieutenant Amuro Ray!

I'm sorry to have you
come all this way.
At ease.

Char...!
Just what are you after,
wanting an alliance with us?

And why did you
come down to Terra?!

We came down to Terra to keep
Neo Zeon's forces in reserve
outside the Earth Sphere.

As a supply base for the fleet...
and as a hiding place,
this world is just right.

You could say we're simply doing
what the Redros Army does.
All in order to oppose them!
Oppose the Redros Army?!

That's right!
Which is precisely why
we wish to ally with you.
Well, hear me out.

The Earth Sphere is now ruled by
the Federation, and Neo Zeon's
autonomy exists in name only.

Worse, the Federation has joined
hands with the Redros Army to build
another group like the Titans.
What did you say?!
It's true, Amuro.

Londo Bell's split, too...
and some of them are forming a
group to fight back against it.

Captain Bright and Ms. Diane
and the others are
at the center of it.
Bright...?

Surely you, too, realize that
the present situation
is not normal.

All of it is tied
to the Redros Army.

True...
That's the natural conclusion,
but...

It was Quess who told me.
Otherwise, I might have ended
up dancing to their tune.

Has the Redros Army been
getting more active in space?

No... same as always.
But the skirmishes keep
on increasing.

You can tell they're trying
to spread the war!
I see...

At present, our goals
align in many respects.

It would be strange not to form
an alliance with such a partner,
wouldn't it?
Talk is cheap.

I simply wish for humanity to move
to a way of life in harmony with
the Earth... and with space.

That has not changed,
then or now.

If you start a meteor drop,
I'll turn against you.
Count on it!

That's fine by me.
But for now, may I take it
that we are agreed?
Amuro...

Yeah...
I know.

I'll report that the talks...
reached an agreement.
That's what you want, Char?
Of course.

Amuro, I thank you for coming
here in person to speak
with me.

Kanji...
You understand, don't you?

...So in the end, Char's
thinking hasn't changed
from before?
Yeah...

Once this is all over...
I'll have to settle things
with him.
A temporary alliance, huh...

rows.notes: Seg 1 [jp] (no header) read as Amuro checking with Kanji. Seg 5: both introduced as [jp] Captain per project decision. Seg 36: [jp] 'meteor drop' (majority form in earlier slices; one slice used 'asteroid drop'). | [editorial 27] 'making more of a showing' awkward | [proofread 3] location card format 'Place: Room' (style sheet)

segments.en: Hm?

Is that...
Quess...?

Hey!
Quess!
You look like you're doing well!

Quess Paraya, attached to
the Rewloola. I've come
to collect my machine!

Hey, no need to be
so stiff about it!

...I'm with the regular Neo
Zeon forces now, you know.
Let's do this properly.

Dahahaha!
Even a scarecrow looks
sharp in a uniform, huh?

Jeez!
Quit fooling around!

Anyway, show me
where my machine is.

Sure!
This way!

It's ready to be moved
out right away.
Give it a check, just in case.

Is it really...
okay for me to take it?

You're the only one who can
use this thing...
Put it to good use, okay?

Of course!
That's the plan!

Oh...
It's all set to
move right away.

You can tell just by
looking at it from outside?

It has a psycommu, so I
can tell. You really kept it
in great shape.

While you were gone, Chan
kept it perfectly maintained.
You'd better thank her!

Yeah......
Hehe... Tell her thanks for me,
and sorry for all the trouble.
Will do!

Want to take a walk
around the ship?

You should probably
say hi to everyone,
right?
Yeah...

Jagd Doga (Quess Custom)
has been removed from the unit.

rows.notes: Seg 6 [jp] rendered as an equivalent idiom (scarecrow/uniform). Chan Agi is female per glossary ('her').

segments.en:
This is the room Kaine
and the others share.
Want to go in?

Yeah!
We didn't really get
to talk earlier.
Kaine and Co.'s Cabin

You...
Are you really Quess?

Kanji, something's
fishy about her!

What?!
There's nothing going on!

Sure, I caused everyone
trouble, and I feel a little
guilty about it, but...

Ma~n,
what a pain that was~!
Yep, yep!

Having a machine that couldn't
fight sitting in the hangar
was a real nuisance, too.

Okay! I'll apologize for
that, honestly!

But... I thought if I told you,
you wouldn't let me go.

I wasn't sure... it would
work out either, you know.

Huuuh?
What the heck happened
to you?

Is this really
the Quess we know?

Jeez, even you're
saying that, Tapp?
Well, I mean...

Ugh...
Let's go, Kanji!
H-Hey!

rows.notes: Seg 4 (no header) read as Kaine continuing; seg 14 (no header) as Tapp continuing (Quess answers 'even you, Tapp'). | [editorial 0] awkward possessive 'Kaine and the others' room'

segments.en:
I'll go to the bridge first.
Elchi's there, right?

Yeah, and a few others should
be gathered there right now.
All right!

Oh? Quess.
You look well.

I'm sorry...
for running off on my own...

It's fine.
It's all in the past now.

Quess, I don't think
you betrayed us.

So you can come back
anytime you want.

Oh... okay...
Thank you.
I'd better get going...
Quuueess!!
Huh...?

Hathaway!
Not now!
Quess!!
Hathaway?!
Just come over here!

Ow!
I'm coming!
Don't be so rough!
That Hathaway...
Come back, Quess!

Not yet...
I've still got so much to do!
So I can't come back to you!

Is being with Char
really that great?!

Ugh...
That's not it!
Try to understand!

No...
No matter what you say,
I can't come back yet!
Quess...!

Quess...
You said you can't come
back 'yet'...

That means this is where
you belong, right?
Right...? Quess...

rows.notes: Seg 13 has no header; read as Quess continuing. Segs 16-17: Hathaway picks up on [jp]/[jp] ('yet').

segments.en: Mom...
Cheer up, Hokuto!
Yeah......

Your mom's alive.
There's still a chance!

Anyway, for now, let's go
report to GEAR headquarters.
Okay...
That concludes my report!

I see...
So that Arthea is
Vega's brother...

...We can at least confirm she's
alive. We must count that
as a mercy amid misfortune.

You must all be tired.
Please, get some rest for today.
GEAR HQ: Lounge
Ginga...
Ngh!
Ginga!!
Hokuto...

Hokuto, come here.
It's all right now...
Ugh... uuu......
Waaaaaaaaaah!!

Dammit!
DAMMIT!!

I don't get it...
I don't understand
any of this anymore!
Ginga...

rows.notes: Seg 13 (no header) read as Keisuke continuing; [jp] rendered 'you don't have to hold it in'. | [editorial 13] trimmed added explanation 'you don't have to hold it in' (accuracy flag); [jp]

segments.en: Still...

I never thought we'd end up
fighting side by side
with Char's fleet...

Now there's no telling
what Le Caine will do...

And how Omega's and Arthea's
forces will respond to that...

Looks like there's a lot
we need to think through.

Grados City
(Formerly New York)

...If only Father hadn't
ordered a retreat back then...

What of Karla?!
She is my subordinate, so why
has she not reported to me?!

After what happened, that
will be impossible for a while.

Mounting another campaign with
a large force will take
an enormous amount of time...

Father knew that, and still he
sent me out! And then he
made me turn back!!

While we sat idle, we let these
Neo Zeon nobodies from who knows
where invade, did we not?!

It is just as you say,
Your Excellency.

Neo Zeon and the Resistance are
marching in step, and they've become
a formidable, troublesome foe.

However, had we pressed on
instead of withdrawing, we might
have been struck from behind.

Roanne Demitrich,
you always arrive at
the very answer I wish for.
You honor me!

...And so?
Are preparations for our
next offensive in order?

To wipe out the new enemy fleet,
I've requested reinforcements from
the homeland. They'll arrive soon.

Good...
And what of Arthea?

He's isolated on the Asia
Continent, but seems to hold a base.
However, something is amiss...

What is it?
Speak.

With Paradigm under enemy control,
Commander Arthea's forces are
completely cut off.

What's more, his supply depot
was utterly destroyed by the enemy.

I wondered how he was managing
to resupply in that state,
so I looked into it...

It seems he is getting
forces from Pentagona.
What did you say?

It does seem to take the
form of a commercial deal...

I thought it might be fair to
regard it as a field decision...

But I've received no such report
from him whatsoever!
Indeed...!

I doubt it, but...
keep investigating Arthea.
And move up the fleet's sortie!
Yes, sir!!

I'm going to see Father.
I won't have him ordering me to
retreat halfway through again!
Le Caine...?

Father!
There's something I must ask you!

Why did you use Karla
to obstruct the battle?!
Why?!

I've yet to receive a satisfying
answer from you since then!

I beg you,
tell me the reason.

Or was that Karla's
own decision?
Aaah!!
I wasn't asking you!

And one more thing.
What do you intend to do with Julia?

I've found out that you're
hiding her somewhere, Father!

Tell me the reason
for that as well!
Father!!
Karla... leave us.
Yes, sir...!
Le Caine...

All of it...
was for your sake.

You believe Gradosians are
a race far superior to
the people of Terra.

It is a fact,
so there's no helping it.

Wise guidance by the superior...
and innocent obedience to it...
That is your principle of rule?
Precisely.

I see...
I understand your thinking.

Karla!
Bring Julia in.
Pardon the intrusion!

Just as I thought,
Father!

Julia,
speak to Le Caine.

Lord Le Caine,
you are mistaken.

Gradosians and the people
of Terra are equals.

At their origin, Gradosians and
the people of Terra are races
that sprang from the same root!

Hmph!
No sooner do you show up
than you spout such nonsense!

No.
It is not a lie.

Gradosians and Terrans
share the same ancestors.

Silence!!
Julia!!

Father, how long will you let
her spout this drivel?!

Please listen!
Lord Le Caine.

The reason your father
took me away,

and the reason he intervened
in the battle with the Layzner...

is that he feared this secret
would reach your ears!

He feared the blow it would deal
you when you learned the secret...

How insolent!
Julia!

I let you talk, and
you get carried away!

He feared the blow
it would deal me?
Don't talk such rubbish!

Father!!
Will you still let Julia
say whatever she pleases?!

Le Caine...
Everything Julia says is true.
There is no lie in it.
Father!!

It is a secret that anyone at the
heart of Grados power must
learn sooner or later.

Why should such a thing
be a secret?

I can't imagine any Gradosian
believing such drivel!

You must learn
the principle of rule.

Rule begins with admitting
that you yourself are evil.

You must know that the blood
of millions has been shed to
maintain the power to rule.

Which is exactly why...
so that the blood shed
will not be in vain...!

Those who rule
must be superior!!

And what does it mean
to be superior?!

Knowledge...? Strength...?
Lineage...? Looks...?
...Such fragile things.

Values like those
shift all too easily...

To rule is power!
The power to hold others down!

And power is, in a word,
"evil"!

What is needed is one who can
first admit to being evil!

One who, knowing everything, can
still reign aloof above it all!!
Ngh...

As I thought... you are still
far too green as a commander,
Le Caine...
That is your view, Father!!

My view is that only the
superior should rule!

If ruling is all it takes,
even a fool can do it!

No!
It must be the superior!!

Do you still not understand?!
Le Caine!!

It is you who do not
understand, Father!

You're trying to flee
from the heights of rule!!

You go too far, Le Caine!
Be gone!

Please wait,
Father!!
I overestimated you!
You are... far too childish!
Urgh...!

This is cowardly, Father!
Just because I won't
bend to your will!

Is that your logic
of rule, Father?

Le Caine!
I hereby dismiss you.
Father!!
Fatheeer!!

Be gone!
Le Caine!!
Hngh!!
Fatheeer!!

Th-The secret of Grados's
creation must be kept...!

J-Julia...
Kill... kill Julia...!!
Kahh...!
Father...?
Father......
Fatheeeeeeer!!
